evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Matched clause structure ('A rollback we have not X is a rollback we do not Y') sets rehearsed-vs-have in deliberate opposition — parallelism and antithesis co-occur.

mints.name: RehearsalAsPossession
mints.title: a thing not rehearsed is a thing not actually had
mints.frame: Is the speaker equating preparation with ownership — collapsing the gap between rehearsal and reality through matched opposition?
